From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC planning: success criteria, timeline & next steps

Hi Sally / Raj —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed plan for the 2-week POC so we can align on success criteria, owners, and any initial risks to track. Please confirm or flag changes.

1) Goal / success criteria (proposed):
   - Functional: Redwood inference produces parity-quality responses on 95% of the 200 evaluation prompts (see spreadsheet).
   - Performance: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for standard prompts; throughput target 20 reqs/sec for batched traffic.
   - Stability: < 1% error rate (timeouts / 5xx) during the POC window.

2) Evaluation plan / deliverables:
   - We will run 200 seeded evaluation prompts you provide + 50 production-like prompts. Results in the shared spreadsheet.
   - Weekly checkpoint calls (Mon) and an end-of-POC demo.

3) Timeline / ownership:
   - Start: Monday 26 Jul 2026 (sandbox access required by Fri 24 Jul).
   - Owners: Stellar side: Raj (engineering) / Procurement (contract). Redwood: Marissa (engagement), Michael (integration & SRE touchpoint), Stephanie (solutions).

4) Next steps (action items):
   - Raj: share sandbox access + 5 representative prompts by Fri 24 Jul.
   - Procurement: confirm statement of work / contract timeline.
   - Marissa (me): share success criteria doc + risk tracker.

I've attached the POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx and a network diagram showing recommended firewall rules. Please review and reply with any edits.

Two things to call out as potential risks up front: 1) long-prompt latency on very large sequences (we'll measure) and 2) VPC/network egress rules may delay sandbox access. We'll put both in the risk tracker and assign mitigations.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Marissa / Sally —

Quick update from initial integration tests this morning. We spun up a connector to the sandbox and ran a few long-form prompts (approx 1,200–1,500 tokens). Observed issues:

- Repeated 504 timeouts on responses for long prompts (>1024 tokens).
- When responses succeed they are taking 6–12s (too slow for our interactive flow).
- Attached a short log and a recording of a failing request (bug_report_452.zip).

This is blocking our ability to validate the latency/throughput success criteria. Can Redwood advise an immediate mitigation? If we need a fix or configuration change on your side, we need an estimated turnaround and escalation path — we have an internal deadline to validate by 2026-07-30.

Thanks,
Raj
Senior Engineer | Stellar Commerce
raj.patel@stellar-commerce.com

Subject: Fwd: POC planning: success criteria, timeline & next steps — blocking bug (INF-452)

Folks — forwarding Raj's report. This is currently blocking their ability to validate the POC. Summary: timeouts and very high latency for long prompts (INF-452). They need an ETA / mitigations within 48 hrs if possible.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Michael: can you reproduce from our side using the logs in bug_report_452.zip and confirm whether this is a model/kernel-level perf regression or a configuration/timeout setting? Please create JIRA INF-452 and attach repro steps.
- Stephanie: coordinate a canary rollback to the previous model variant or temporary scale-up (dedicated burst nodes) as a short-term mitigation. Also draft a customer-facing note and timeline.
- Vivek: if Michael confirms a kernel/regression, please escalate to Platform Eng and loop in the runtime lead. We'll request P1 priority.

Customer outreach plan: I will reply to Raj & Sally with our immediate mitigation and an ETA once we have an initial repro (target within 12 hours). Offer: if this causes a missed success metric we should discuss a credit for their trial; bring finance if needed.

Please update me in-thread and paste the JIRA link when created.

Thanks —
